resolution: The case keeps moving (`MovesIn`, a present reduction from potency to act), causing a perfection (`CausesIn`, with 'cause of being' at esse) and simple priority (`PriorSimply`, DEF-SIMPLE-PRIORITY) as separate predicates, and every passage between them is an explicit premise: STMT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-IS-CAUSE-OF-BEING (open, bare) from simple priority to cause of being; STMT-EVERY-CREATED-AGENT-ACTS-AS-APPLIED-TO-ACT-BY-GOD (sourced, q.105 a.5: an agent whose being God causes is itself moved when it moves) linking causing being and moving; STMT-DIRECTING-IS-MOVING for the quinta via. Aristotle's four modes classify causes in general and are not premises of the root path.
